product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with a panel and 2 boards
steps.instruction: Join a panel and 2 boards (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A panel and 2 boards are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the TROGEN chair. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (panel, about 96 cm), B (board, about 94 cm), C (board, about 94 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.

steps.title: Add 2 rails
steps.instruction: Attach 2 rails (D, E) to what you have built so far, as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
